body: I think it makes sense not to return any renderState here
this will be done after merge, once the format is set in stone

this code could potentially be part of the widget instead of the connector since vue (and react) can rely on the host's ability to mount and unmount, but that would mean the widget itself becomes slightly more complicated, since it would have both rendering logic and widget mounting logic
for custom widgets without type this will serialise as `{}`, do we see an alternative?
different way of emptying the container?
root container needs to be made _inside_ container
mounted widgets need to be unmounted
`transformItems` should be required until we implement the `attributes` later.
why isn't the order test2 → test1 ?
the widgets themselves don't have a useful concept of ordering, therefore the only important thing is that the right ones are mounted more than their order.
